steps.description: Land on the homepage and confirm it loads with visible navigation/content.
steps.expected: The homepage renders with a clear way to navigate to other sections (e.g. projects/work, about, contact).

steps.description: Find and open the projects/work section.
steps.expected: A page or section listing projects/work is shown, with at least one project visible.

steps.description: Open one project to see its details.
steps.expected: A project detail view opens showing more information about that specific project.

steps.description: Find a way to contact the site owner (link, button, or form), without submitting any personal data.
steps.expected: A contact method is visible and reachable — e.g. a contact page, form, email link, or social links.
